scope: Independent ROOT conditional models. No physical execution, acquired components, source substitution or qualified invention.

nitrogen_inventory_and_cost.scope: Fixed producer design/sensitivities and rounded financial categories, not all nitrogen-recovery architectures, measured guard affinity or a matched quote.

electrode_charge.limits: All charge assigned to irreversible Cu2+ dissolution is a Faraday-law bookkeeping scenario, not measured corrosion. Reversal does not prove local material, oxidation, ion or water restoration; all auxiliary/reset energy unpaid here.

compliance_and_peel.peel_limits: Inextensible zero-bending steady tape peel only. Creating the peel geometry, edge access, bending, stretching, friction and reset are not free. Existing dry grippers already use peel release.
compliance_and_peel.limits: Introduced two-state design sensitivity; no measured Goff, compliance-switch mechanism, mode transfer or new material.

blister_screens.circular_blister_formula: G=p^2*a^4/(128*D); fixed uniform pressure, clamped thin elastic plate
blister_screens.limits: No edge crack, mixed-mode law, plasticity, residual stress, interface thickness or validated real joint.
